name: Robtex Network Intelligence
description: Look up DNS records, check IP and domain reputation against 100+ blocklists, query AS/network data, and explore the Bitcoin Lightning Network — all directly from Claude. Robtex provides 44 tools covering forward and reverse DNS lookups, IP geolocation and threat intelligence, domain popularity rankings from 5 independent sources (Majestic, Tranco, Cloudflare Radar, Umbrella, CrUX), hostname parsing, MAC address vendor lookups, and Lightning Network node/channel discovery. Free, no authentication required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Robtex Network Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Robtex Network Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.robtex.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Robtex Network Intelligence MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Robtex Network Intelligence scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Robtex Network Intelligence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Robtex Network Intelligence lists 45 MCP tools, including lookup_dns, dns_a, dns_aaaa, dns_mx, dns_ns, dns_txt, dns_cname, dns_soa, dns_ptr, reverse_lookup_dns_records, reverse_lookup_mx, and reverse_lookup_ns.

_published_faq.name: Does Robtex Network Intelligence MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Robtex Network Intelligence does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Robtex Network Intelligence is developed by Robtex. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
